Root cause: a config push lowered max.poll.interval.ms on the webhook-dispatcher consumer group; slow handlers exceeded it and triggered repeated rebalances.

human_critique: States who (3,412 merchants), where (us-east-1), what (delayed, 14-41 min) and that nothing was lost. Matches the facts.

Title: orders table lock during schema migration

Customer impact: 6.2% of checkout attempts in eu-west-1 failed with a 500 error (about 9,870 failed checkouts). Customers could retry; no orders were double-charged.
Internal impact: migration rolled back manually.

human_critique: Rate, count, region, retry behaviour, and no double charge. Correct.
